answer_1.quote: Our work addresses task variability in citation text generation - a widely studied scholarly NLG task aiming to increase efficiency of scientific work.
answer_1.outputs: Paragraph‑level citation texts for related‑work sections

answer_2.quote: We employ a range of measurements and metrics to characterize the citation texts generated by the LLMs... Conventional metrics... ROUGE‑L, BERTScore, SciBERTScore, BLEURT. NLI‑based metrics... TRUE and SummaC.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a small‑scale human generation study... annotators were asked to check whether the generated paragraphs mention the extracted atomic facts.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluated generated paragraphs against gold references using the pyramid method, checking coverage of extracted atomic facts.
